_om: Hovedpersonen in English (Nosy Parker, rusj.no/en/nosy-parker/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. «Stolen» is the hot seat; the reader hands out stars («stjernesvar» = a star answer). The questions are in data.en/sporsmal.json, written for the UK.
Én av dere sitter i den varme stolen og: One of you sits in the hot seat and answers the group’s questions. Then it’s the next person’s turn.
Mobilen velger hvem som begynner. Den so: The phone picks who goes first. The person sitting next to them reads the questions aloud.
Den i stolen svarer på 3, 5 eller 8 spør: Whoever is in the hot seat answers 3, 5 or 8 questions. The group is welcome to dig a little deeper.
Var svaret ekstra morsomt, ærlig eller o: Was the answer extra funny, honest or surprising? Tap the star before the next question. Most stars wins.
Vil du ikke svare? Trykk «Bytt spørsmål»: Don’t want to answer? Tap ‘New question’ – that’s always fine. You can also swipe the card away.
Trykket feil på stjerna? Trykk en gang t: Tapped the star by mistake? Tap it again and it’s gone.
«Familie» passer for alle aldre. «Dypt»: ‘Family’ suits all ages. ‘Deep’ works best when you have plenty of time.
Skru av stjernene hvis dere bare vil pra: Turn the stars off if you just want to chat.
Sist: {spillere} i stolen, {sporsmal}: Last time: {spillere} in the hot seat, {sporsmal}
Sist: {spillere} i stolen, {sporsmal} og: Last time: {spillere} in the hot seat, {sporsmal} and {stjerner}
Quick – good for a big group.
Lenge i stolen. Her blir det avsløringer: A long time in the hot seat. Secrets will come out.
Just the right time in the hot seat.
Den som leser, deler ut stjerner. Flest: The reader hands out stars. Most stars wins.
{sporsmal} besvart. Nå vet dere litt mer: {sporsmal} answered. Now you know each other a bit better.
Godt jobba! {sporsmal} besvart – og {stj: Well done! {sporsmal} answered – and {stjerner} handed out.
{sporsmal} besvart. Neste gang: trykk på: {sporsmal} answered. Next time: tap the star when an answer deserves it.
The star has been taken away.
Dere går rett til kåringen. Den med fles: You’ll go straight to the results. Whoever has the most stars wins.
You can always start a new one.
{spill} – hvem fikk flest stjernesvar? 🔥: {spill} – who got the most star answers? 🔥
